description: This file defines extension methods for the IGrainContext interface to register and retrieve resource factory registries used in Orleans distributed transactions.

classes.name: ResourceFactoryRegistry<T>
classes.description: A dictionary mapping string names to factory functions for resources of type T.

methods.name: RegisterResourceFactory
methods.description: An extension method to register a resource factory with a given name into the context's resource factory registry.

methods.name: GetResourceFactoryRegistry
methods.description: An extension method to retrieve or create the resource factory registry associated with the context.
